items.question: What is the fine under the UAE Unemployment Insurance scheme for a worker who does not subscribe to the scheme?
items.fact: Non-subscribing worker fined 400 AED under unemployment insurance.

items.question: Within how many days from the end of the employment relationship must a worker submit a claim under the UAE Unemployment Insurance scheme?
items.gold: Within 30 days from the end of the employment relationship.
items.fact: Unemployment insurance claims must be submitted within 30 days of employment ending.
